ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a curve graph of the relationship between plant interception amount and rainfall amount and rainfall duration. The horizontal axis is labeled “rainfall amount (millimeters),” and the vertical axis represents plant interception amount; the figure has curves for different rainfall durations, such as curves labeled “25” and “50.” Overall, along the same rainfall-duration curve, as the rainfall amount on the horizontal axis increases from small to large, the plant interception amount on the vertical axis also rises accordingly and tends to stabilize. Then reason: a relatively large total amount of plant interception corresponds to a higher vertical-axis position in the figure; under the same rainfall-duration condition, a higher plant interception amount usually appears in a larger rainfall-amount range. Therefore, when the total amount of plant interception is relatively large, the rainfall amount should be relatively large.
